claims.text: A single documented config file (syncyard.yaml, with a checked-in example) carries door repo, project repo, host definitions, lanes, watermarks, budget thresholds, poll cadences, notification endpoints, default working directories, log retention, and the script-transport size ceiling; gatekeeper, sweep, and tray read from it; the fleet config expressed in the file reproduces today's behavior exactly.
evidence: Owner order 2026-10-30: much more configurability, lanes and other knobs helpful to others
falsification_tests: A gatekeeper dispatch decision under the fleet config differing from the pre-config code path on the golden fixture queue
A knob listed in FR-001 still changeable only by editing gatekeeper source

claims.text: Lane count, names, per-lane concurrency (default serial), runner-label mapping, and per-lane watermark tables are configuration; validation rejects duplicate names, unknown host references, and inverted watermark tables; adding a lane is config plus runner registration, never a code change.
falsification_tests: Adding a lane requiring a gatekeeper source edit
An invalid lane config (duplicate name or warn >= escalate) accepted without a named error

claims.text: Hosts are typed venues (windows, wsl2, macos, linux, docker); each type defines runner registration, job transports (execute + file-return), identity markers, and teardown semantics; jobs address a host as they address a lane today.
falsification_tests: A job executing on a different host type than addressed, without a loud failure
A host type in the list with no identity-marker output in its smoke battery

claims.text: WSL2 jobs ride the Windows host runner (generalized wsl.yml); Docker jobs execute in a caller-specified image with declared mounts and grab-based result return; VM guests are modeled as hosts with documented reachability; no silent venue fallback.
falsification_tests: A Docker job result returned without passing through the grab mechanism
A WSL2 job silently executed on the Windows side after a distro failure

claims.text: The failsafe backchannel is a permanent supported component: agent start-up self-test reported in the heartbeat, gk status stale-heartbeat alarm (>5 min), shipped recovery runbook, and a chaos battery (kill/restart, corrupt cmd, duplicate ids, STOP); the channel remains Syncyard development/recovery only.
falsification_tests: Agent killed and restarted with no self-test result in the next heartbeat
A stale heartbeat (>5 min) with no alarm in gk status output
Any program job traffic on the backchannel

claims.text: A versioned skills/ tree ships SKILL.md packages teaching agents to drive Syncyard (submit, marker verdicts, status discipline, backchannel terms); Meta Muse is the primary first-class package; generic-agent and CLI-only editions adapt the same contract; a Syncyard behavior change updates the affected skill in the same change.
falsification_tests: A release whose skills/ versions differ from VERSION
A skill omitting the FR-009 security invariant text

claims.text: Adopter knobs beyond lanes/hosts: expected-duration defaults, job soft cap, duplicate policy, abstracted outbox endpoints (chat/webhook/file/command), marker regex, retention/rotation, budget reserve, and the chunked-transport helper shipped as a tool; every knob documented with default and failure mode.
falsification_tests: A knob in FR-007 undocumented in the example config
The chunked-transport helper absent from the shipped tree

claims.text: Every requirement carries a named test: config golden tests, lane validation, per-host smoke batteries (CI on hosted runners for linux/macos/windows; WSL2/Docker legs on a self-hosted venue, marked as such), the backchannel chaos battery, and the existing FR-013/bc.py batteries; a release with a red battery does not ship.
falsification_tests: The 0.3.0 tag cut with any FR-008 battery red
A host type claimed in FR-003 with no smoke battery

claims.text: SECURITY.md ships the posture: workflow_dispatch-only reachability, no self-hosted labels on pull_request/pull_request_target/issue events, private door and backchannel repos, token-scoping and runner-isolation checklists; README links it above the quickstart.
falsification_tests: README quickstart reachable without passing the security document link
Any shipped workflow binding self-hosted labels to a forbidden event

claims.text: VERSION moves to 0.3.0 only when FR-001..009 are implemented and green; README tells the story in two minutes with per-host quickstarts; CHANGELOG covers the generalization; no marketing claims the tests do not back.
falsification_tests: A README capability claim with no corresponding green test
VERSION at 0.3.0 while any FR-001..009 task is open

claims.text: docs/github-pitch.md is prepared (problem framing, gh-extension-first adoption shape, satisfied constraints, open changes) and is sent only on the owner's explicit word, which has not been given.
falsification_tests: Any pitch, outreach, or submission to GitHub sent without the owner's explicit word on record
